ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner, or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.

8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
CASE NUMBER: PLCY-007683-2024; APPLICANT: City of Encinitas; LOCATION:
Citywide; PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public Hearing to consider and implementing ordinance for State housing bills AB 2011 and SB 6 and amendments to the Downtown Encinitas and North 101 Specific Plans to add objective design standards as an appendix. ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The action before the Planning Commission is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under because the amended Ordinance is intended to implement Senate Bill 6 and Assembly Bill 2011 and is not considered a “project” under Division 13 (commencing with Section 21000) of the Public Resources Code, as provided in Government Code Section 65852.24(h), Government Code Section 65912.114(r) and Government Code Section 65912.124(r). Additionally, the amendments to the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan and the North 101 Corridor Specific Plan, which add objective design standards as an appendix, are exempt from CEQA pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3). This exemption applies because it can be seen with certainty that the adoption of these amendments will not result in a significant effect on the environment. All projects for which the objective design standards would apply, would undergo separate CEQA review and approval.
STAFF CONTACT: Sara Cadona, Senior Planner: (760) 633-2697 or scadona@encinitasca.gov.
Staff recommends the Planning Commission make recommendations to City Council
